mapper.select: select distinct student_id from spas_score_detail where paper_id = #{paperId} order by student_id

select distinct d.student_id from spas_score_detail d join spas_student st on st.student_id = d.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = d.paper_id where 1 = 1
and (st.dept_id = #{deptId} or st.dept_id in ( select t.dept_id from sys_dept t where cast(#{deptId} as varchar) = any(string_to_array(t.ancestors, ',')) ))
and p.subject_id = #{subjectId}
order by d.student_id
mapper.insert: insert into spas_student_knowledge_stat( student_id, knowledge_id, subject_id, attempt_count, avg_rate, weighted_rate, last_paper_id, last_exam_date, weak_level, calc_time ) values ( #{studentId}, #{knowledgeId}, #{subjectId}, #{attemptCount}, #{avgRate}, #{weightedRate}, #{lastPaperId}, #{lastExamDate}, #{weakLevel}, now() ) on conflict (student_id, knowledge_id) do update set subject_id = excluded.subject_id, attempt_count = excluded.attempt_count, avg_rate = excluded.avg_rate, weighted_rate = excluded.weighted_rate, last_paper_id = excluded.last_paper_id, last_exam_date = excluded.last_exam_date, weak_level = excluded.weak_level, calc_time = now()
mapper.select:
select st.student_id as id, st.student_name as name from spas_student st where st.del_flag = '0' and st.status = '0'
order by st.student_no asc

select s.student_id as "studentId", s.knowledge_id as "knowledgeId", s.weighted_rate as rate from spas_student_knowledge_stat s join spas_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' where 1 = 1
and s.subject_id = #{subjectId}

select q.question_id as "questionId", q.question_no as "questionNo", q.full_score as "fullScore", qk.weight as weight, avg(d.rate) as "avgRate", count(distinct d.student_id) as "studentCount", p.paper_name as "paperName" from spas_question_knowledge qk join spas_paper_question q on q.question_id = qk.question_id join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = q.paper_id left join spas_score_detail d on d.question_id = q.question_id left join spas_student st on st.student_id = d.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' where qk.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId}
and ( st.student_id is null or st.dept_id = #{deptId} or st.dept_id in ( select t.dept_id from sys_dept t where cast(#{deptId} as varchar) = any(string_to_array(t.ancestors, ',')) ) )
and (st.dept_id in #{did} or st.student_id is null)
group by q.question_id, q.question_no, q.full_score, qk.weight, p.paper_name, q.question_order order by q.question_order asc, q.question_no asc

select st.student_id as "studentId", st.student_no as "studentNo", st.student_name as "studentName", d.dept_name as "deptName", case when coalesce(sum(s.attempt_count), 0) > 0 then sum(s.weighted_rate * s.attempt_count) / sum(s.attempt_count) else avg(s.weighted_rate) end as rate, coalesce(sum(s.attempt_count), 0) as "attemptCount", max(s.last_exam_date) as "lastExamDate" from spas_student_knowledge_stat s join spas_knowledge leaf on leaf.knowledge_id = s.knowledge_id and leaf.node_type = '2' and leaf.status = '0' join spas_student st on st.student_id = s.student_id and st.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = st.dept_id where ( leaf.parent_id = #{knowledgeId} or cast(#{knowledgeId} as varchar) = any(string_to_array(leaf.ancestors, ',')) )
and (st.dept_id = #{deptId} or st.dept_id in ( select t.dept_id from sys_dept t where cast(#{deptId} as varchar) = any(string_to_array(t.ancestors, ',')) ))
and st.dept_id in
#{id}
group by st.student_id, st.student_no, st.student_name, d.dept_name order by 5 asc nulls last, st.student_no asc
